implementation_gate: Before running, implement trace extraction and model-guided ordering without inspecting held-out solutions, and verify equivalence to frozen solver with guidance disabled.
name: CIRCUIT3
objective: Test whether learned search guidance transfers to held-out Boolean circuit synthesis tasks and compounds after retraining.

primary_hypotheses.H1: guided_round1_30000 solves strictly more than 18 of the 41 held-out tasks; otherwise refuted
primary_hypotheses.H2: guided_round2_30000 solves strictly more held-out tasks than guided_round1_30000; otherwise refuted
